          ╔═ HELP ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗          
          ║  right         next image           playlist                                 ║          
          ║  windows                            wheel                scroll the list     ║          
          ║  alt+g         show/hide equalizer  click                select a track      ║          
          ║  i             album info on/off    double click         play it             ║          
          ║  alt+i         choose a cover       right click          track actions       ║          
          ║  alt+r         look the cover up    click `sorting`      order the playlist  ║          
          ║  p             playlist on/off      click `gravity`      create a related    ║          
          ║  alt+s         listening activity list                                       ║          
          ║  alt+e         choose a playlist    player                                   ║          
          ║  tab           next pane            click the transport  transport           ║          
          ║  shift+tab     previous pane        click footer status  toggle its mode     ║          
          ║  alt+1..5      focus a pane         click or drag bar    seek                ║          
          ║  appearance                         wheel over bar       seek 5s             ║          
          ║  alt+t         next theme           click or drag VOL    set volume          ║          
          ║  a             animations on/off    wheel over VOL       volume 5%           ║          
          ║  equalizer                          click analyzer       next visualization  ║          
          ║  e             equalizer on/off     right click          play or pause       ║          
          ║  ]             next preset          equalizer                                ║          
          ║  up/down, j/k  choose a filter      click [ON ]          enable or bypass    ║          
          ║  left/right    filter gain, 1 dB    click the chevrons   change preset       ║          
          ║  shift+left/rightfilter gain, 10    click a filter       select it           ║          
          ║dB                                   wheel over the panel previous / next     ║          
          ║  enter         bypass the filter  filter                                     ║          
          ║  a             add a filter         album                                    ║          
          ║  d             remove it            click cover          open full image     ║          
          ║  [             previous preset      click < / >          previous / next art ║          
          ║  library                            click title / artist open music database ║          
          ║  l             browse the library   overlays                                 ║          
          ║  /             search it            click outside        close the picker    ║          
          ║  space         add the selection    click `close`        close a panel       ║          
          ║  a             add the record       click `settings`     what that panel     ║          
          ║  ctrl+s        save the playlist  controls                                   ║          
          ║  ← / →         change column                                                 ║          
          ║  general                                                                     ║          
          ║  esc           close what is open                                            ║          
          ║  ? / F1        this help                                                     ║
